snippet.title: Build Your Business Empire | Lotwick Hill – Tycoon Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Build shops, set prices and compete for customers in Lotwick Hill, a business tycoon and economic strategy game for PC.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5288610/Lotwick_Hill/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=official_gameplay_trailer&utm_content=description

Your first shop. Your next empire.

Start in the 1930s and grow your business through the decades in a living harbour city. Bid for property, choose what to sell and give customers a reason to pick your shop over the competition.

• Build and manage shops, apartments and hotels.
• Set prices, keep shelves stocked and compete with rival businesses.
• Personalize your shopfronts and watch customers queue, buy and leave with their purchases.
• Follow deliveries from the harbour, explore the streets and take a balloon ride above the city.
• Face computer-controlled rivals in Free Play and challenges.

Online multiplayer is planned for the Steam launch: compete with up to 4 human players, with up to 6 players in total including AI rivals.

Coming to Steam for Windows PC in October.

Which shop would you open first?

Follow Lotwick Hill on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@lotwickhill
